let VdaMachineRole = 0;
let DdcMachineRole = 1;
let RegisteredState = 1;
let Machines =
    Citrix_Machines
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
    | where CatalogDisplayName in (_catalog) or isempty(_catalog)
    | where DesktopGroupDisplayName in (_deliveryGroup) or isempty(_deliveryGroup)
    | where NameHost in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where isempty(_tag) or Tags contains _tag
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Id;
let MachineSummary =
    Machines
    | summarize
        SiteCount = dcount(SiteGuid),
        VDACount = countif(MachineRole == VdaMachineRole),
        RegisteredCount = countif(MachineRole == VdaMachineRole and CurrentRegistrationState == RegisteredState),
        DDCCount = countif(MachineRole == DdcMachineRole);
let CatalogCount = toscalar(
    Citrix_Catalogs
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
    | where Name in (_catalog) or isempty(_catalog)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, Name) by Id
    | summarize dcount(Id));
let DeliveryGroupCount = toscalar(
    Citrix_DesktopGroups
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
    | where Name in (_deliveryGroup) or isempty(_deliveryGroup)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, Name) by Id
    | summarize dcount(Id));
MachineSummary
| extend
    UnregisteredCount = VDACount - RegisteredCount,
    RegisteredPercent = iff(VDACount > 0, round(100.0 * RegisteredCount / VDACount, 1), real(null))
| mv-expand MetricPack = pack_array(
    pack("Metric", "Sites", "MetricValue", todouble(SiteCount)),
    pack("Metric", "Machine Catalogs", "MetricValue", todouble(CatalogCount)),
    pack("Metric", "Delivery Groups", "MetricValue", todouble(DeliveryGroupCount)),
    pack("Metric", "VDAs", "MetricValue", todouble(VDACount)),
    pack("Metric", "Registered", "MetricValue", todouble(RegisteredCount)),
    pack("Metric", "Unregistered", "MetricValue", todouble(UnregisteredCount)),
    pack("Metric", "Registration %", "MetricValue", todouble(RegisteredPercent)),
    pack("Metric", "Controllers", "MetricValue", todouble(DDCCount)))
| project Metric = tostring(MetricPack.Metric), MetricValue = todouble(MetricPack.MetricValue)

let DesktopGroups =
    Citrix_DesktopGroups
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
    | where Name in (_deliveryGroup) or isempty(_deliveryGroup)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Id
    | where isempty(_tag) or Tags contains _tag;
let Applications =
    Citrix_Applications
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
    | where DesktopGroupName in (_deliveryGroup) or isempty(_deliveryGroup)
    | where tobool(Enabled) == true
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Id
    | where isempty(_tag) or Tags contains _tag;
let PublishedDesktops =
    Citrix_PublishedDesktops
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
    | where DesktopGroupName in (_deliveryGroup) or isempty(_deliveryGroup)
    | where Enabled == true
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Id
    | where isempty(_tag) or Tags contains _tag;
print
    DeliveryGroups = toscalar(DesktopGroups | summarize dcount(Id)),
    PublishedApps = toscalar(Applications | summarize dcount(Id)),
    PublishedDesktops = toscalar(PublishedDesktops | summarize dcount(Id))
| mv-expand MetricPack = pack_array(
    pack("Metric", "Delivery Groups", "MetricValue", todouble(DeliveryGroups)),
    pack("Metric", "Published Apps", "MetricValue", todouble(PublishedApps)),
    pack("Metric", "Published Desktops", "MetricValue", todouble(PublishedDesktops)))
| project Metric = tostring(MetricPack.Metric), MetricValue = todouble(MetricPack.MetricValue)

let VdaMachineRole = 0;
let RegisteredState = 1;
Citrix_Machines
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
| where CatalogDisplayName in (_catalog) or isempty(_catalog)
| where DesktopGroupDisplayName in (_deliveryGroup) or isempty(_deliveryGroup)
| where NameHost in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where isempty(_tag) or Tags contains _tag
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Id
| where MachineRole == VdaMachineRole
| summarize
    VDAs = count(),
    Registered = countif(CurrentRegistrationState == RegisteredState)
    by Site = SiteName
| extend RegisteredPercent = iff(VDAs > 0, round(100.0 * Registered / VDAs, 1), real(null))
| order by RegisteredPercent asc, Site asc

let VdaMachineRole = 0;
let TimeBucketSize = iff((_endTime - _startTime) <= 2d, 1h, 1d);
Citrix_Machines
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
| where CatalogDisplayName in (_catalog) or isempty(_catalog)
| where DesktopGroupDisplayName in (_deliveryGroup) or isempty(_deliveryGroup)
| where NameHost in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where isempty(_tag) or Tags contains _tag
| where MachineRole == VdaMachineRole
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, CurrentPowerState) by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBucketSize), Id
| extend PowerState = tostring(CurrentPowerState)
| summarize VDAs = dcount(Id) by TimeBucket, PowerState
| order by TimeBucket asc, PowerState asc

let VdaMachineRole = 0;
let RegisteredState = 1;
let Catalogs =
    Citrix_Catalogs
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
    | where Name in (_catalog) or isempty(_catalog)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Id
    | project
        CatalogId = Id,
        ['Machine catalog'] = Name,
        ['Session support code'] = SessionSupport,
        ['Provisioning type code'] = ProvisioningType,
        ['Allocation type code'] = AllocationType,
        ['Persistent user changes code'] = PersistentUserChanges;
let MachineCounts =
    Citrix_Machines
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SiteName in (_site) or isempty(_site)
    | where CatalogDisplayName in (_catalog) or isempty(_catalog)
    | where DesktopGroupDisplayName in (_deliveryGroup) or isempty(_deliveryGroup)
    | where NameHost in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where isempty(_tag) or Tags contains _tag
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Id
    | summarize
        ['#VDAs'] = countif(MachineRole == VdaMachineRole),
        ['#Registered'] = countif(MachineRole == VdaMachineRole and CurrentRegistrationState == RegisteredState)
        by CatalogId;
Catalogs
| join kind=fullouter MachineCounts on CatalogId
| extend
    ['#VDAs'] = coalesce(['#VDAs'], 0),
    ['#Registered'] = coalesce(['#Registered'], 0),
    ['%Registered'] = iff(['#VDAs'] > 0, round(100.0 * ['#Registered'] / ['#VDAs'], 1), real(null))
| project
    ['Machine catalog'],
    ['Session support code'],
    ['Provisioning type code'],
    ['Allocation type code'],
    ['Persistent user changes code'],
    ['#VDAs'],
    ['#Registered'],
    ['%Registered'],
    CatalogId
| order by ['Machine catalog'] asc
